notes: Starter pack for Indian GST slabs. Rate notifications are made by CBIC on the recommendations of the GST Council. Official CBIC notification PDFs timed out in the source research; encoded rates that rest on GST Council and PIB releases are verified_starter, reviewed on 2026-11-13. Not a filing position.

semantic_mappings.rule: Use for supplies that take the 18% GST slab, the ordinary rate both before and after the 56th Council rationalisation.
Use for supplies that take the 5% merit / lower slab. From 22 September 2025 this slab is widened; it is still reduced, not standard.
Use only for historical supplies that took the 12% slab through 21 September 2025. Do not use it for supplies on or after 22 September 2025.
Use for the de-merit path: 28% through 21 September 2025, then 40%. Do not use luxury for a different tax such as compensation cess.
Use for the nil-rated 0% slab as described in the Council / PIB materials. Do not assume this is IGST Act s 16 export zero-rating.
Use for supplies that the exemption notifications relieve from GST. The lists themselves are not copied here.

rates.notes: Combined GST (CGST+SGST/UTGST or IGST). The 18% standard slab has been part of the rate structure from the GST appointed day (1 July 2017; Notification 1/2017-CT(Rate) dated 28 June 2017 is named in the PIB FAQ but was not opened). The 56th GST Council restated 18% as the standard rate from 22 September 2025 under Notification 9/2025-CT(Rate) (also not opened). This pack keeps one open 18% version; the 2025 restatement is recorded in the policy diff.

rates.notes: From 1 February 2026, pan masala, tobacco and products (other than bidis), cigarettes, and nicotine inhalation products move to 40%, and compensation cess on those goods is nil, as summarised in the GST Council December 2025 newsletter (Notifications 19/2025-CT(Rate) and 03/2025-Compensation Cess (Rate), dated 31 December 2025, not opened).
